art_note: Flat mockup presentation with generic supplier imagery lowers the luxury perception.
desc_en: This long-sleeve blouse presents a fluid and lightweight design. Crafted from soft polyester, it offers an impeccable drape and a delicate touch against the skin. Its cropped hem silhouette brings a contemporary and versatile mood, ideal for pairing with tailored trousers or midi skirts. Each piece is made to order with meticulous attention to detail, available with worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Esta blusa de manga larga presenta un diseño fluido y ligero. Confeccionada en suave poliéster, ofrece una caída impecable y un tacto delicado sobre la piel. Su silueta de corte asimétrico aporta un aire contemporáneo y versátil, ideal para combinar con pantalones de sastre o faldas midi. Cada pieza es elaborada bajo pedido con atención al detalle y disponibilidad de envío a todo el mundo.
details_en:
· Crafted from high-quality polyester
